{{Top|leg}}
'''Methyl alcohol''' was an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage favored by [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fans]]. It was their drink of choice, just like [[Water/Legends|water]] was to many other [[Species/Legends|species]].

==Behind the scenes==
In reality, methyl alcohol is another word for [[Wikipedia:methanol|methanol]], a highly toxic chemical.
